item.title: Boutique Manager: Automating Retail Operations with Bash
item.description:
Executive summary

Boutique Manager is a shell scripting project for a small clothing shop scenario. Its command-line menu brings together product registration, inventory updates, sales, stock alerts, reporting, logging and backups.

The project originated from applying concepts studied in the Hands-on Introduction to Linux Commands and Shell Scripting course. It is a practical automation exercise, rather than a claim of deployment at a commercial retailer.
